notices.title: Hardware Sidecar Security Update
notices.message: Existing Sidecar users must re-run the installer on every PVE/PBS host to enable the new IP access restrictions introduced in V5.1.2.

notices.title: Proxmox Datacenter Manager is coming to V5.2.0
notices.message: V5.2.0 will introduce PDM as a new module alongside PVE, PBS and CLUSTER, providing centralized monitoring of Proxmox infrastructure through a single Datacenter Manager connection.
